scope: Only four specified flat-background points, 9 native decoded frames/9 accurate PNGs/22 already-captured Chromium canvas PNGs. No full-image equivalence claim.

video.metadataMethod: Read-only ffprobe in this independent review; no media decode/conversion was executed by reviewer.

method.standard: BT.709 nonlinear YCbCr limited-range inverse matrix for 8-bit samples
method.arithmetic: Exact rational arithmetic, avoiding premature coefficient/term rounding.
method.rgb8Quantization: Clamp final RGB channel to [0,255], then floor(value+1/2); explicit nearest-integer, half-up reference convention.
method.sampling: Planar Y at y*1920+x; Cb/Cr at floor(y/2)*960+floor(x/2). A 5x5 flat neighborhood was verified in each plane, so chroma interpolation/siting cannot change these flat-point values.
method.gammaHandling: This is Y-prime/Cb/Cr to R-prime/G-prime/B-prime matrix arithmetic; no transfer-curve or primaries conversion applied.
method.comparisonCriterion: Exact RGB8 equality required and obtained at all selected points; no tolerance relaxation was used. A separate implementation may differ by up to 1 LSB due to quantization, which is not needed here.

limitations: No new browser, render, TTS, source change, freeze, re-encoding or frame decode was performed by this reviewer; existing native planes and PNG artifacts were read only.
Only this new math-independent.json was written; older QA and publication acceptance reports were untouched.

Parent-supplied prior default-FFmpeg background observation [28,26,22] was not reread here. It differs from the independently derived body reference [30,28,24] by -2 per channel; that observation does not override direct native-plane arithmetic.
No full-image SSIM/MAE, colored edge/chroma resampling, glyph/layout, sound, physical-device display or whole-film colorimetric acceptance is claimed. Parent owns the full same-frame comparisons.
